tasks.title: Create the solution, API host and shared build settings
tasks.dod: `dotnet build Rochambeau.slnx` succeeds with zero warnings. Rochambeau.slnx contains src/Rochambeau.Api (net10.0, Minimal API). Directory.Build.props sets Nullable, ImplicitUsings, TreatWarningsAsErrors and analyzers. .editorconfig exists. Program.cs wires ProblemDetails, the global exception handler, OpenAPI, TimeProvider, SignalR and GET /health. Empty src/Rochambeau.Api/Common/ and Modules/ folders exist.

tasks.title: Wire the backend test harness and the app-boots smoke test
tasks.dod: `dotnet test Rochambeau.slnx` passes. tests/Rochambeau.UnitTests (xUnit) contains a trivial passing test. tests/Rochambeau.IntegrationTests (xUnit + WebApplicationFactory + Testcontainers PostgreSQL fixture) contains a smoke test: the app boots against a real PostgreSQL container and GET /health returns 200.

tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL, AppDbContext and EF Core migrations with an initial empty migration
tasks.dod: `docker compose up -d` starts PostgreSQL 17. AppDbContext (Npgsql, snake_case naming) is registered from configuration. A dotnet-ef local tool manifest exists. The initial empty migration in src/Rochambeau.Api/Common/Persistence/Migrations/ applies (`dotnet ef database update`) and reverts (`dotnet ef database update 0`) cleanly. The S2 integration smoke test still passes with migrations applied to the container.

tasks.title: Create the React + TypeScript web client with tooling and a smoke test
tasks.dod: In web/: `npm run build`, `npm test` (Vitest + React Testing Library; a smoke test renders the App shell) and `npm run lint` (ESLint + Prettier check) all succeed. Tailwind CSS, React Router, TanStack Query and @microsoft/signalr are installed. The Vite dev server proxies /api and /hubs to the API. Empty src/features/, src/shared/ui/ and src/shared/realtime/ folders exist.

tasks.title: Add the GitHub Actions CI workflow (build + test + lint)
tasks.dod: The workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml is valid YAML and runs on push and pull_request. It installs .NET 10 and Node LTS and runs exactly the map's build_cmd, test_cmd and lint_cmd (Docker is available on ubuntu-latest for Testcontainers). Running the same commands locally succeeds. It cannot run remotely until a GitHub remote exists.

tasks.title: Write CLAUDE.md from the foundation conventions
tasks.dod: CLAUDE.md states the build/test/lint/migration commands, the module layout and boundary rules, the error/ID/time/persistence/real-time conventions, and the frontend layout, consistent with docs/architecture-map.md and ADRs 0001–0003.
